title: Balanced finite integral normalization of native adic tensor realization
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a scheme $X$ with $\ell$ invertible, and normalized native realization and tensor data of [def-sf-native-adic-realization-data]. For each finite coefficient field, define a finite normalization datum using the normalized ordinary-to-completed tensor presentation of [def-sf-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation]: ordinary scalar extension on complexes has the balanced isomorphism $s\otimes(x\otimes y)\mapsto(s\otimes x)\otimes(1\otimes y)$ on every homogeneous section; good K-flat representatives remain K-flat; the ordinary derived comparison agrees with this map through the universal cochain counits and ambient K-flat models; and the realization tensorator agrees with this comparison, inverse quotient completion and the recorded integral realization through the actual inclusion tensorator [def-sf-common-stage-inclusion-tensor-comparison]. These are data and predicates only, with no assertion of their existence.
